notes: Calibration test-bed hero — NOT part of any real card series (group: angel-primes). Physique stays a fixed description, same convention as the Drakn sisters. Palette (Soft Pearl White / Warm Champagne Gold / Dove Grey) is a fixed, generic 'angel' wardrobe scheme governing only the test outfit, not the subject's natural colouring. Hair and eye colour are generic on purpose: both Primes are the test for any original photo, so the wording keeps the reference image's own hair and eye colour unchanged (no enhancement, no recolouring, no eye glow in their scenes). The other angels may use more specific looks.
